title: Hands Spread Out Toward Heaven
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The temple stood all done and bright,
And all the people came.
King Solomon knelt down and prayed,
"Hear all who call Your name."

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father hears your prayer,
Wherever you may be.
So pray for others, near and far,
And He hears you and me.

[Verse 2]
He spread his hands up to the sky
For all beneath the sun.
A bright cloud filled the temple then,
They knew God heard each one.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and softly pray
For someone that you love.
Heavenly Father's right here, close,
Not only up above.

[Chorus]
mood: Kneeling music. A slow, open pulse breathes under the voice like a whole crowd growing quiet as a king kneels, spacious and reverent, matching Solomon's wide prayer for everyone. The chorus swells softly, like a cloud filling a room with light. By the last verse the breathing slows and sinks lower, the crowd gone home, one small prayer whispered in a dark bedroom before sleep.
